Guides

How to get what you want out of TopoSaic.

One guide per part of the job: how sharp the terrain is, what gets drawn on it, how it turns into filament, how to print a landscape too big for one bed, and how to keep the setup that made it.

🎨

Printing in color

Set the palette or read it off satellite imagery of the place, pick the filament each layer prints from, and import cleanly into Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer — including why Bambu's import dialog piles up duplicate filaments, and how to stop it.

Data & attribution

TopoSaic draws on public map data. Publicly shared prints, images, and files must keep the data-source credits recorded in each manifest, or place them near the work.

Elevation: Mapzen Terrain Tiles & Mapterhorn · Land cover: ESA WorldCover · Roads, railways, lifts, water, buildings, and place search: OpenStreetMap via Overpass & Nominatim.
